notes.title: 🎉 5,000 Sales Milestone & Update News! 🎉
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439433/719c30babdd13d40eee1eb2f1ad482c03f1f926f.png"]We’re thrilled to share that Monmusu Paradise Visitor, after a month sale, has reached 5,000 copies sold! Thank you so much for your support — your feedback and enthusiasm keep us going. 💖

We’re also working on the next update, but it’s taking a little longer than planned due to engine improvements and final language checks. We want to make sure everything runs smoothly and gives you the best experience possible.

Thank you for your patience, and stay tuned for more exciting updates!

notes.title: 🎉 WE DID IT! Final Test Complete for Monmusu Paradise ~ Visitor ~ 🎉
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 🎮✨

Thank you for 5k wishlists!!!

I’m thrilled to announce that the final test for Monmusu Paradise ~ Visitor ~ is officially complete! The game is looking better than ever, and I couldn't be more excited for you all to experience it! 💖

From the demo, we have added :
- Minigames: Bartender and Quizzes for you to try
- Freemium Adventure Mode, no quest, just sex!
- As promised 9 scenes is fully implemented!
- Side Quests : and some more secrets inside ;)

This has been such an incredible journey, and I couldn’t have made it this far without your support and patience. Thank you so much for being with me every step of the way!

Currently we're working on final polish related with audio, translations and Credits,
We have given Supporters to try the game using the keys we have sent, if you're inclined to.

Once again thanks for your patience and we'll polish and update this game the best we can.

notes.title: Game Update: We’ve Been Listening to You!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 🙌

We’ve just pushed out a new update for Monmusu Paradise Visitor — and it’s all thanks to the amazing feedback you’ve shared with us! We truly appreciate all your input, and we’ve been working hard to make the game even better:

Bug Fixes: Addressed multiple in-game bugs for improved performance.

Gameplay Balance: balanced fishing score and money got, also making some items more affordable.

Your input is invaluable to us. Thank you for helping shape the future of Monmusu Paradise


Also, don't forget we're still in the middle of wishlist campaign!

Breaking through 4k to the next goal of 5k wishlist!

Join us to clear the rest of the campaign!

notes.title: Demo Hotfix Patch Balance
notes.content:
Updating some balance and buttons for better playing experience:
- speed up walking for fishing 
- updating lighting for fishing
- shorten the walking distance when out of area
- updating the keyboard inputs so it can use full controller than just keyboard
- adding more buttons for menus
- adding key manual in description

Keyboard
======================
Movement : Arrow Keys
Accept : Z/Enter
Cancel : X/Esc/Tab/Space
Menu : Esc/Tab/Space

Controller
======================
Movement : D-Pad
Accept : A
Cancel : B
Menu : Start
